paragraphs.p1: I'm a fullstack developer with a product mindset. I don't just write code — I think about why the product exists, who uses it, and what makes it worth building well.
paragraphs.p2: I started as a frontend developer obsessed with interaction details, and gradually moved into backend, infrastructure, and systems design. Now I own the full stack — from database schema to the last pixel.
paragraphs.p3: Outside of shipping products, I write about engineering culture, and mentor junior developers who are figuring out their path.
paragraphs.p4: I work best in small, focused teams where quality is taken seriously and people care about what they're building. My preferred way of working is Scrum or Agile — short iterations, regular feedback, and close collaboration with the team and the product owner.
